data.narrative:
Xage Security is a Series B-stage defense and security company that has raised $80M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies in the Defense & Security sector at the same stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods are applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $80M raised proxy, implying a valuation of $152M. Peer-median analysis examines 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.0B and a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. This wider dispersion reflects heterogeneous risk profiles and market positioning within the defense tech cohort.

Synthesizing both methods yields a triangulated range of $129M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $576M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty regarding Xage's relative positioning within the peer set—whether the company aligns with earlier-stage benchmarks near the $152M stage-progression mark or commands valuations closer to the $1.0B peer median. Key uncertainties include differentiation in product defensibility, customer concentration, and replicability of growth rates observed among higher-valued peers. The median estimate of $576M balances both methodologies and represents a reasonable midpoint absent additional operational or market data.
